name: Tamil Nadu Road Development Company Limited
summary: The Tamil Nadu company that built and manages the East Coast Road along the coast south of Chennai.
ownership: Government of Tamil Nadu, through TIDCO
about: TNRDC was formed in 1998 to build and run roads in Tamil Nadu on a commercial footing, with the state's industrial development corporation TIDCO as its main shareholder. Its best-known project is the East Coast Road from Chennai towards Puducherry, which it widened and now maintains — a road that turned a slow coastal route into the drive that made Mahabalipuram and the beach towns south of Chennai into weekend destinations.
facts: Manages the East Coast Road between Chennai and Puducherry.
Owned by the Tamil Nadu government through TIDCO.
Also works on other state road and infrastructure projects.
